meta_title: Crypto Payments for Digital Downloads & Course Sellers | Dynopay
meta_description: Accept crypto payments for digital downloads and courses with no chargebacks, 1.5% fees, and funds direct to your wallet. Live in 10 minutes with Dynopay.
h1: Crypto Payments for Digital Downloads & Course Sellers
subheading: Stop losing revenue to chargebacks and refund fraud. Accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDC, and 10+ cryptos with funds paid directly to your wallet.
intro_paragraph: Selling courses, ebooks, or software means dealing with payment processors that side with buyers in disputes—even when your product was delivered. Dynopay eliminates chargebacks entirely by accepting cryptocurrency payments that settle directly to your wallet. You stay in control of your funds from the moment a customer pays, with a flat 1.5% fee and no monthly costs. Support for Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDC, Solana, and stablecoins on multiple chains means your buyers can pay how they prefer while you avoid the refund abuse that erodes margins.

features.title: Zero Chargeback Risk on Sales
features.description: Cryptocurrency transactions are final. Once a customer pays for your course or download, the funds are yours. No dispute reversals 90 days later, no processor holds, no fraudulent refund claims after content access.

features.title: Receive Funds in Your Wallet
features.description: Dynopay is non-custodial. Every payment settles directly to the wallet you control—Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDC, or any of 12+ supported assets. No waiting for batch payouts or trusting a third party with your revenue.

features.title: Flat 1.5% Fee, No Monthly Charges
features.description: Pay only when you earn. A simple 1.5% platform fee plus a small fixed component on each transaction. No setup costs, no monthly subscription, no hidden gateway fees eating into tight digital product margins.

how_it_works: Sign up with your email, verify, and create your company profile in under three minutes.
Add one payout wallet address for the crypto you want to receive: BTC, ETH, USDC, or others.
Generate a payment link or embed the checkout widget on your sales page—go live in 10 minutes.

faqs.question: Do I need to hold cryptocurrency to accept crypto payments for my courses?
faqs.answer: No. You only need a wallet address to receive payments. Dynopay sends funds directly to your wallet—you choose whether to hold crypto, convert it through an exchange, or cash out. We never custody your funds, so you control the timing.

faqs.question: Can customers dispute or reverse a crypto payment after downloading my product?
faqs.answer: No. Cryptocurrency transactions are irreversible once confirmed on the blockchain. Unlike credit cards or PayPal, buyers cannot file chargebacks or payment disputes. Once your customer pays, the funds are final and settle directly to your wallet.

faqs.question: What cryptocurrencies can I accept for selling digital downloads and courses?
faqs.answer: Dynopay supports Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Solana, XRP, and stablecoins including USDC and USDT on Ethereum, Polygon, and Tron. Buyers pay in their preferred asset; you receive funds in the wallet you specify during setup.

faqs.question: How long does it take to start accepting crypto payments on my course platform?
faqs.answer: Under 10 minutes. Sign up, verify your email, create a company profile, add one payout wallet address, then generate a payment link or install the checkout widget. No merchant account approvals, no multi-day underwriting, no paperwork.

faqs.question: What are the fees for accepting crypto payments with Dynopay?
faqs.answer: Dynopay charges a flat 1.5% platform fee per successful transaction, plus a small tiered fixed component: one dollar for orders under 100 dollars. No setup fees, no monthly fees, no hidden costs. You pay only when you make a sale.

cta_headline: Start Accepting Crypto Payments in 10 Minutes
cta_body: Create your account, add a wallet, and go live today. No monthly fees, no chargebacks, funds direct to you.
